question: The surface areas of the two spheres are in the ratio of 64 ∶ 81. Find the ratio of their volumes, in the order given
solution:
Given:

The ratio of the surface areas of two spheres = 64 ∶ 81

Formula used:

The surface area of the sphere = 4πr2

The volume of the sphere = (4/3)πr3

where r is the radius of the sphere

Calculation:

let r1 and r2 be the radius of the sphere

(surface area of the sphere)1/(surface area of the sphere)2 = 64/81
